attributes.board_name: Connecticut Commission of Pharmacy (Department of Consumer Protection)

rules.accepted_credit_types: ACPE, CME, CNE and State Board of Pharmacy programs (ACPE numbers ending -L are live, -H written/home study, -C combination)
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE does not apply to a pharmacist applying for the first year of a license.
rules.carryover: Not allowed: CE earned in one calendar year cannot be carried into the next.
rules.alternatives: Retired pharmacists may hold an inactive license without CE; returning to practice requires 30 hours, at least 10 live.
rules.audit_note: Signed statement under penalty of false statement at renewal; certificates are not sent unless requested in a random audit. Keep them at least 3 years.

topics.who: All pharmacists: pharmacy law or drug law (federal or any state's law; live or written)

rules.notes: CE year is the calendar year (Jan 1-Dec 31); at least 5 of the 15 hours must be live. Licenses expire annually on January 31. Board page lists a $100 renewal fee, but CGS 20-601 as amended from July 1, 2025 says $105, so the fee is left out.
